descriptions.aider: AI pair programming in your terminal.
descriptions.amp: Sourcegraph's AI coding agent for CLI and VS Code.
descriptions.claude: Anthropic's official CLI agent for Claude.
descriptions.cline: Autonomous coding agent CLI by Cline Bot.
descriptions.codex: OpenAI's coding agent for the terminal.
descriptions.copilot: GitHub's official Copilot coding agent for the terminal (the new copilot CLI, not the retired gh copilot extension).
descriptions.cursor: Cursor's agent-mode CLI, sharing context with the editor.
descriptions.gemini: Google's open-source AI agent for the command line.
descriptions.goose: An open-source AI developer agent by Block (CLI — beta).
descriptions.nanoclaw: Containerized agent runtime — each Agent Group runs in its own Docker container (Claude Agent SDK), bridged to the workspace over a native channel.
descriptions.openclaw: Open-source coding agent with multi-model support.
descriptions.kimi: Powered by Moonshot AI over an OpenAI-compatible API, strong on long context.
descriptions.hermes: Nous Hermes — self-improving AI with tools, profiles, memory and messaging.
descriptions.mini-swe-agent: A minimal shell-based coding agent for fixing issues and modifying code in a workspace.
descriptions.pi: Earendil's Pi coding agent for the terminal — headless RPC mode, many providers.

genericHints.apiKey: API key for the selected provider. Leave blank to reuse a key already in your environment.
genericHints.baseUrl: Endpoint URL. Leave blank for the hosted service; set it for a relay, proxy or self-hosted gateway.
genericHints.model: Model name. Change it when using a relay or proxy — their channels rarely match the default.
genericHints.provider: Provider id. Leave blank to reuse the agent's existing configuration.
genericHints.token: Access token. Leave blank to reuse a token already in your environment.

AIDER_MODEL.label: Model
AIDER_MODEL.hint: Model to use, e.g. sonnet, gpt-4o, openrouter/anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet. May be left blank to let Aider auto-select — but if you set a key, the provider must be determinable.

AIDER_PROVIDER.label: Provider
AIDER_PROVIDER.hint: Which provider the API key belongs to: auto, openai, anthropic, openrouter, gemini, deepseek, openai-compatible. `auto` infers from the model name; set it explicitly when the model name doesn't identify the provider.

AMP_API_KEY.label: API key
AMP_API_KEY.hint: Amp API key (create one at ampcode.com/settings) — leave blank if you have run `amp login`.

AMP_URL.label: Server URL
AMP_URL.hint: Amp server URL for enterprise/self-hosted deployments. Leave blank for the default.

ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.label: Base URL
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.hint: Anthropic-compatible base URL. The default works for the direct Anthropic API; change it for a proxy or relay.

ANTHROPIC_MODEL.label: Model
ANTHROPIC_MODEL.hint: Model name. Change it when using a relay or proxy — their channels rarely match the default.

CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.label: Subscription token
CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.hint: Long-lived token from `claude setup-token`, run on a machine that's already signed in. Paste it here to reuse a Pro/Max subscription on this machine — no API credit and no browser sign-in needed. Leave empty if you sign in above.

CLINE_API_KEY.label: API key
CLINE_API_KEY.hint: API key for the selected provider — or leave blank and run `cline auth` to sign in.

CLINE_MODEL.label: Model
CLINE_MODEL.hint: Model id for the selected provider.

CLINE_PROVIDER.label: Provider
CLINE_PROVIDER.hint: Provider id (cline, anthropic, openai, openrouter, …). Leave blank for Cline's configured default.

CODEX_MODEL.label: Model
CODEX_MODEL.hint: Model name. Change it when using a relay or proxy — their channels rarely match the default.

COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN.label: GitHub token
COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN.hint: GitHub token with Copilot access (optional — you can also sign in by running `copilot`, or rely on GH_TOKEN / gh auth).

COPILOT_MODEL.label: Model
COPILOT_MODEL.hint: Model to use (optional; leave blank for the account default).

CURSOR_API_KEY.label: API key
CURSOR_API_KEY.hint: Cursor API key for CLI authentication.

DEEPSEEK_API_BASE.label: DeepSeek base URL
DEEPSEEK_API_BASE.hint: Custom endpoint for native deepseek/… models. Leave blank to use DeepSeek's default.

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.label: DeepSeek key
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.hint: DeepSeek API key — used for deepseek/… models. Connects directly to api.deepseek.com; no base URL needed.

GEMINI_API_KEY.label: API key
GEMINI_API_KEY.hint: Google AI Studio API key — get one at aistudio.google.com/apikey (optional if you sign in with Google).

GEMINI_MODEL.label: Model
GEMINI_MODEL.hint: Model name. Change it when using a relay or proxy — their channels rarely match the default.

GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL.label: Base URL
GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL.hint: Gemini-compatible base URL. The default works for Google AI Studio; change it for a proxy or custom gateway.

GOOSE_MODE.label: Tool permission mode
GOOSE_MODE.hint: Headless tool-permission mode. `auto` runs tools without approval (required for the workspace); `chat` disables tools. Approval modes are coerced to `auto`.

GOOSE_MODEL.label: Model
GOOSE_MODEL.hint: Model name for the selected provider (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-6). Leave blank to reuse your existing config.

GOOSE_PROVIDER.label: Provider
GOOSE_PROVIDER.hint: Goose provider id (e.g. openai, anthropic, google, openrouter, ollama). Leave blank to reuse your existing Goose config.

GOOSE_PROVIDER__API_KEY.label: API key
GOOSE_PROVIDER__API_KEY.hint: Provider API key. Leave blank to reuse the Goose keyring/config, an OAuth provider, or a local provider.

GOOSE_PROVIDER__HOST.label: Base URL
GOOSE_PROVIDER__HOST.hint: Custom provider endpoint (optional — for proxies or self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints).

KIMI_API_KEY.label: API key
KIMI_API_KEY.hint: Moonshot / Kimi API key (also accepts MOONSHOT_API_KEY).

LLM_API_KEY.label: API key
LLM_API_KEY.hint: API key for the selected provider. Leave blank to reuse a key already in your environment.

MSWEA_COST_LIMIT.label: Cost limit
MSWEA_COST_LIMIT.hint: Optional per-run cost limit in USD. Leave blank for mini's default.

MSWEA_MINI_CONFIG_PATH.label: Config file path
MSWEA_MINI_CONFIG_PATH.hint: Path to a FULL mini config file (YAML), optional. It REPLACES the built-in default config rather than merging, so provide a complete file. Leave blank to use the default.

MSWEA_MODEL_NAME.label: Model
MSWEA_MODEL_NAME.hint: Model to use (routed through LiteLLM), e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5 or gpt-4o. Optional when a model is already configured via a config file.

NANOCLAW_AGENT_GROUP.label: Agent Group
NANOCLAW_AGENT_GROUP.hint: NanoClaw Agent Group id or name to bridge to this agent.

NANOCLAW_HOME.label: NanoClaw path
NANOCLAW_HOME.hint: Path to your NanoClaw checkout (optional if `ncl` is on PATH).

OPENAI_API_KEY.label: API key
OPENAI_API_KEY.hint: OpenAI API key (optional if using the Codex subscription via `codex login`).

OPENAI_BASE_URL.label: Base URL
OPENAI_BASE_URL.hint: OpenAI-compatible base URL. The default works for the OpenAI API; change it for a proxy or relay.

PI_MODEL.label: Model
PI_MODEL.hint: Exact model id exposed by the provider or relay, such as claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-5-codex, or deepseek-v4-flash.

PI_PROVIDER.label: Provider
PI_PROVIDER.hint: Choose anthropic for native/relay Claude, openai for native/relay OpenAI, deepseek for DeepSeek, or openai-codex for a ChatGPT subscription login.

PI_API_FORMAT.label: API protocol
PI_API_FORMAT.hint: Keep auto for native providers. For a relay choose anthropic-messages, openai-completions, or openai-responses as documented by the relay.

PI_BASE_URL.label: Relay base URL
PI_BASE_URL.hint: Leave blank for native APIs; set this for a relay, proxy, or self-hosted endpoint. $t(common.appName) configures Pi without models.json.

PI_API_KEY.label: API key
PI_API_KEY.hint: API key for the selected provider or relay. Leave blank to reuse an existing Pi /login session.

PI_THINKING.label: Reasoning effort
PI_THINKING.hint: One of off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Leave blank for the model default.

PI_TRUST_PROJECT.label: Trust project files
PI_TRUST_PROJECT.hint: Off by default. When set to 1, Pi loads .pi/settings.json, extensions and skills from the working directory — that is executable code from the repository, so only enable it for projects you trust.
